llm.summary: This SharePoint skill is coherent and disclosed, but it asks users to install and allowlist an unpinned external plugin that handles Microsoft OAuth and broad SharePoint write, delete, sharing, and permission operations.

dimensions.detail: Hosted ClawLink OAuth and request forwarding are disclosed and proportionate to an integration skill, but users should understand that SharePoint content and requests pass through this external integration path.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install instructions fetch `clawhub:clawlink-plugin`, add it to `tools.alsoAllow`, and restart the gateway, but the artifact does not pin a reviewed version or digest or provide a verification step beyond describing the plugin as verified.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires explicit confirmation and previews for writes, but the enabled capability set is broad and includes permanent deletion, permission changes, organization sharing links, uploads from URL, and activity logging without documenting exact OAuth scopes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill changes OpenClaw configuration so the ClawLink plugin remains allowed in future chats, and ClawLink manages OAuth token refresh for the connected Microsoft account.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the documented capabilities: SharePoint and OneDrive management through ClawLink and Microsoft Graph, including reads, writes, file operations, sharing, permissions, and site management.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the ClawLink plugin and OAuth consent carefully before installing. Use an account with the minimum SharePoint permissions needed, confirm every write or permission change, and prefer installing only if you accept a hosted third-party integration handling SharePoint requests and token refresh.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The external ClawLink plugin and OAuth proxy are expected for this skill's purpose, but the artifact-backed install path is unpinned and the plugin receives high-impact SharePoint authority after allowlisting, so this remains a Review concern rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
